facts.statement: The expansion's storyline: someone took the stolen runes of the Shimmering Stone, threatening all of Snowy Hill, and players must find the Shimmering Stone and defeat the villain.
facts.quote: Alguém tomou as runas roubadas da Pedra Cintilante e ameaça toda a Colina Nevada!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - ¿Qué novedades hay? (JCC do Free Realms Prévia de Carta - Baron von Darckcheat!)
article_summaries.summary: A Portuguese-language SOE news preview for the Free Realms Trading Card Game (JCC) expansion Baron von Darkcheat. It says the expansion has 146 new cards and new loot, sets up the story of stolen runes from the Shimmering Stone threatening Snowy Hill, and previews the Captain Ironsides Machine-sphere card with 'progressive power-ups' for attack and defense. The date is taken from the '11.14.11' stamp and the 'published 11 months, 2 weeks ago' line is not used.
